topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session, outlines the learning outcomes, and sets the historical context for the lecture.

topics.label: Tumor virology and the discovery of oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how historical investigations of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and led to laboratory assays for cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of cancer-associated genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer mutations are classified functionally and how allele dosage and tumor suppressor inactivation disrupt cell cycle checkpoints.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the molecular causes, DNA repair failures, and cellular stresses that generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumorigenesis and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the stepwise accumulation of somatic and inherited mutations drives cancer progression and influences malignancy.

topics.label: Conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation, recaps the learning outcomes, and recommends further reading.
